name: seller-adjustable-terms
title: Seller adjustable terms (pre-authorized unilateral changes)
description: Fields of a purchase the buyer pre-authorizes the seller to change without an offer, and the bounds. Ports adcp#8102 core/seller-adjustable-term.json and makes the constraint a tagged union on `kind` (PR #8102 review), so a later kind is another variant, and an unknown kind fails closed instead of being misread.

extends.semantics: Readback in get_media_buys: the changes the seller applied under the accepted allowances. The seller writes it with the same uri@digest as the accepted commercial_terms entry, and announces each change through the core change feed (account.change_recorded, origin seller_system); the extension has no notification type of its own.

promotion.rule: 2+ independent adopters with substantively similar allowances for 90+ days

changelog.change: Current version: allowances in commercial_terms, the media_buy_state readback (AppliedAdjustments), the normative spec, the conformance suite, and the reference code, all pinned by the digest. Uses the kernel container ExtensionEntry with `data`, and the host properties `extensions` and `extensions_state`. The spec and manifest text follow the documentation style guide; the rules and their IDs are unchanged.
